headline: For EV/EBITDA, the best recipe (Growth and ROIC peers) has a median error of 0.405 in the validation years, against 0.426 for the industry median.
notes: sales_growth_3y is unavailable in FY 2016–2017 (not enough prior years); recipes that rank on it use their other features in those years.
